snapshot_policy: Only the exact published Cargo package payloads that sidecar/Cargo.lock resolves are extracted under upstream/, each verified against its Cargo.lock registry checksum. Each payload includes Cargo's normalized and original manifests, VCS identity, lockfile, the package's selected source/include files, and its licence/readme files. Workspace qualification evidence, unrelated crates, bindings, generated native extensions and sites are excluded.
release_gate: The extracted package payloads and checksums identify the published dag-ml-data, dag-ml-data-core, dag-ml-data-provider 0.2.16 release exactly; Studio runtime resolution remains pinned to the same registry checksums in sidecar/Cargo.lock.
